summary:
T6 is not accepted in round 1. The structure is sound and matches the brief: the escalation fixed_draft -> spill -> draft_free, the flotation-first closest-fail ranking, kernel errors handled as failed evaluations, per-module t_max,i, the S8 solver records and stage3_report. All tests pass: 32 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped, 1073.8 s. I reproduced every number the implementer reported exactly (C, S, D, G).

The optimisation itself does not deliver what AGENTS section 3 items 27 and 32 require, and the tests assert only structure, so they cannot detect it:
(1) Case C is stored as a failed closest fail with objective 0.0146901 (T_pitch deviation 12.12 %). A design inside the bounds, t = [0.139902 0.135073 0.0762] m, z_ballast = -2.218129 m, meets both equalities (flotation 9.6e-14, GM 0). Through the code's own B-rep, F9 and F10 path it passes the check (T_pitch deviation 9.16 %) with objective 0.00839728. The stored design is therefore neither the optimum nor correctly failed.
(2) Phase 2, which minimises the item-27 objective, is skipped whenever fmincon's phase-1 point is marginally outside tol_eq. Instrumented, phase 1 ended at a GM residual of -1.32e-06 against a tolerance of 1e-6. The profile shows one fmincon call, and the stored objective is 2.97e-4 where 0 is attainable.
(3) Case D stores flotation residual 0.291, fully submerged at the vs bound -0.5. Yet the lightest design floats exactly at vs = 0.937237 m (flotation residual 0 by the code's path). In D, Octave's sqp ran 0 iterations in every step.
(4) Contract section 7 item 3 is not met: F7 runs 3 times at an unchanged draft.
Octave's weak sqp contributes to (1) and (3): in C, phase 2 ended infeasible with residuals 6.4e-4 and 2.7e-3, and best_of_step fell back to the phase-1 point. The code has no feasibility restoration, so a single sqp failure ends the step. The C1 run in the plan's acceptance is deferred to J2 under the owner's rule.
verified: git -C /home/user/wt/T6 status clean; HEAD = origin/task/T6 = 3e1d450e711dee79b5036b275f16345031c256ce; merge base = task/T5 = 31f470f; diff --name-status: no renames. Files changed: 5 in +realise/+modular_precast (owned T0b->T5->T6), tests/octave_shims/fmincon.m (+6 lines, test-only, not in the section-4 ownership map) and 4 tests. Each commit carries the attribution lines.

Full suite rerun (MWEC_REGRESSION unset): 32 passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped, 33 total, 1073.8 s. test_precast_stage3_solve PASS 670.6 s, test_precast_solve_failed_evals PASS 24.1 s, test_precast_inner_ranges PASS 4.2 s, test_precast_stage3 PASS 174.9 s.

Reproduced the implementer's numbers exactly. C: flotation 1.16e-08, GM 6.13e-08, T_pitch deviation 0.1212. S: steps split>fixed_draft>spill, flotation 1.6e-08, GM 1.27, t2 = 99.619 mm = t_max. D: draft_free ran, vs -0.5, flotation 0.291, GM -0.701, t1 448.508 mm. G: split>fixed_draft>spill, flotation 7.85e-08, GM -0.997, status failed. Module-volume sum minus hull volume = 0 m^3 for C and S.

Re-derived the mass bounds in Python from the box dimensions (x in [-1, 1], y in [-0.75, 0.75], z in [-2.5, 0.5]). S M_max = 4.5*1200 + 1.224*1200 + 3.276*1.2 = 6872.7312 kg < 7687.5 kg displaced. D M_min = 4805.4951 kg > 307.5 kg displaced at vs = 2.4, and M_min < rho_w V_hull = 9225 kg, so the lightest design floats at vs = 0.9372373547 m. The code path agrees: flotation residual 0, GM residual -1.27 (grader_case_d_float.m).

Derived properties from AGENTS section 5 ('What the two equalities imply'): at the Stage-2 draft with both equalities held, T_heave deviation is 3.26e-09 in C and 4.35e-12 in the grader test; the Z_CG deviation equals GM2*res_GM/|Z_CG2| (0.103981*2.05e-7/1.220647 = 1.746e-08, against 1.747e-08 measured).

Solver options (sqp, StepTolerance 1e-8, OptimalityTolerance 1e-6, ConstraintTolerance 1e-6, MaxIterations 300, MaxFunctionEvaluations 2000) are identical to v1.0 8da92d5 modular_precast/solve.m lines 197-204: no invented tolerance.

The objective uses props.periods.heave and .pitch, which F9 documents as coupled (fixes I20). The status rule is check.pass (flotation plus the four metrics); the GM residual is printed as 'solver equality, not in the check'.

Forced-infeasible case G (GM2 = 100 m, cylinder, through F14 run.m): status failed, 'GM' in check.failed, reason contains 'closest fail', final_props equals the stored realised props, results.Final3D is unchanged and the draft is kept (flotation 7.85e-08). run.m calls plot_modular_precast and export_stage3 for every status; both are switched off in tests per contract section 3.

Escalation logic by reading and by run: spill runs only when the equalities are not both met at fixed_draft; draft_free runs only when flotation fails (solve.m line 85); in G the draft is not released after a failed GM; spill uses the same variable with upper bound e(k*+2); modules wholly below z_ballast get t = NaN.

Shape-assumption grep on the changed files (sqrt(.*pi, pi*r, compute_rmin, R_eq, cos_alpha, L_k, max_slope, homothetic, old names): the only hit is the pre-existing T5 closed-form oracle of the cylinder fixture in test_precast_stage3.m line 35, which is legitimate because the fixture is a cylinder.
own_test:
Scratch tests are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-MWEC-Mass/4eed5a18-bc85-5f1a-b911-b09cefd00ef6/scratchpad/grader/T6/.

(a) grader_known_optimum.m, a test with a known exact answer. On the box fixture at vs = 0, I built a buildable design x*: t = [0.10 0.14 0.09] m, with z_ballast = -2.205238369 m found by fzero for flotation (mass 7687.5 kg). Its props became the Stage-2 record, and the Stage-2 densities of modules 2 and 3 were swapped so that the split differs from x*. Known answer: the objective is 0 at x* and both equalities hold there (measured: objective 0, flotation 1.18e-14, GM 0, check pass). The run ended accepted at fixed_draft: Z_CG deviation 1.747e-08, which equals the derived GM2*res_GM/|Z_CG2| = 1.746e-08, and T_heave deviation 4.35e-12. But the stored objective is 2.97e-4 (T_pitch 1.72 %) and t1 = t_min, not 0. Instrumenting a scratch copy of solve.m (grader_known_optimum_instr.m) shows phase 1 ended at GM residual -1.32e-06 > tol 1e-6, so phase 2 never ran; the Octave profile shows fmincon called once and hydrostatics_at_draft called 3 times at the unchanged vs.

(b) grader_case_c_scan.m and grader_case_c_point.m scan the equality manifold of case C on the closed form. The closed form reproduces the stored C design (z_ballast -2.098247, T_pitch deviation 0.1212). The scan finds t = [0.139902225 0.135072727 0.0762] m, z_ballast = -2.218128890 m, inside every bound. Through the code's realise_modules, F9 and F10 this design gives check pass 1, flotation 9.6e-14, GM 0, T_pitch deviation 9.16 % and objective 0.00839728 < 0.0146901 stored. Instrumenting C (grader_case_c_instr.m): phase 1 reached both equalities (GM 9.97e-09); phase 2 ended with exitflag -2 at flotation 6.4e-4, GM 2.7e-3 and objective 0.00733; best_of_step then fell back to the phase-1 point.

(c) grader_case_d_float.m: the lightest D design floats at vs = 0.937237355 m with flotation residual 0 (GM residual -1.27), so flotation is reachable when the draft is released.
violations: AGENTS section 3 item 27 and section 5 item 11 (closest fail = the optimum when the equalities hold; accepted when the check passes): case C is stored as status failed, 'closest fail: the fixed_draft result meets the equalities'. Its objective is 0.0146901 and T_pitch deviates 12.12 %. A design within the bounds meets both equalities and passes the check, with objective 0.00839728 and T_pitch deviation 9.16 %: t = [0.139902 0.135073 0.0762] m, z_ballast = -2.218129 m. Verified through the code's realise_modules, F9 and F10.

AGENTS section 3 item 32 (flotation held in every reported state) and item 20 (the draft is released to reach mass balance): case D stores flotation residual 0.291 at the vs bound -0.5. The lightest design floats exactly at vs = 0.937237 m, inside [-0.5, 2.5]. Every D step ran 0 iterations; draft_free stopped with 'operator *: nonconformant arguments (op1 is 4x9, op2 is 0x0)'.

AGENTS section 3 item 27 (Stage 3 minimises the deviation): solve.m line 203 runs phase 2 only when fmincon's returned phase-1 point meets tol_eq. Measured: phase 1 ended at GM residual -1.32e-06 against tol 1e-06, so phase 2 was skipped (one fmincon call in the profile). The stored objective is 2.97e-4 where 0 is attainable at the known design x*.

Contract section 7 item 3 (F7 keyed by vs: one call while the draft is fixed): hydrostatics_at_draft is called 3 times at the unchanged Stage-2 vs (Octave profile, steps split>fixed_draft). The calls are solve_and_extract.m line 96, then the empty store('hs') cache in solve.m lines 361-373, then the final evaluate at solve_and_extract.m line 149 with hs = []. The implementer's report says 'F7 is called once per vs and cached'.

required_fixes.issue: Phase 2 (the item-27 objective) starts only when fmincon's returned phase-1 point x meets both equalities within tol_eq. Phase 1 minimises a squared residual, so it routinely stops just outside tol: GM residual -1.32e-06 against 1e-06 was measured, although an evaluated neighbour had 2.05e-07. The step then stores a feasible point whose objective was never minimised (2.97e-4, while 0 is attainable).
required_fixes.fix: After phase 1, take the best evaluated point of the step by rank_key (class 0 when any point holds both equalities) as the phase-2 start, instead of fmincon's return value. Run phase 2 whenever that point is class 0.
required_fixes.verify: Rerun grader_known_optimum.m: the profile must show 2 fmincon calls in fixed_draft, and the stored objective must be below the phase-1 objective 2.97e-4. Add the known-optimum construction (Stage-2 record = props of a buildable design x* at the same draft) as a committed test. Assert that both equalities hold, status is accepted, and the stored objective is no larger than the objective at the phase-1 point.

required_fixes.issue: When phase 2 ends off the equalities, its progress is discarded and best_of_step falls back to the phase-1 point. Case C: phase 2 ended with exitflag -2 at objective 0.00733 and residuals 6.4e-4 / 2.7e-3; the step stored objective 0.0146901 and status failed. A design within the bounds passes the check with objective 0.00839728 (t = [0.139902 0.135073 0.0762] m, z_ballast = -2.218129 m).
required_fixes.fix: Make the fixed-draft solve reach the optimum on the equality manifold. Options: restore the equalities from phase 2's end point (re-run phase 1 from there) and repeat phase 2 while the restored objective decreases; and/or eliminate flotation in each evaluation by the monotone 1-D ballast root that the split already uses (fzero on z_ballast).
required_fixes.verify: test_precast_stage3_solve case C must end with status accepted. The design above, which passes F10 through the code path, shows that one exists. The stored objective must be <= 0.00839728, and both equalities must hold within 1e-6.

required_fixes.issue: The spill and draft_free steps hand a start with a large flotation residual straight to sqp and do not establish flotation when it is reachable. D: start flotation residual 14.6; all steps ran 0 iterations; draft_free crashed at iteration 0. The stored design has residual 0.291 at the vs bound, while the lightest design floats exactly at vs = 0.937237 m.
required_fixes.fix: When flotation fails at a step's start, restore it first by the monotone 1-D root before phase 1. In draft_free, solve vs for M = rho_w V_sub(vs), bracketed by P.vs_bounds (F7 per vs, cached). In spill, solve z_ballast over [e(k*), e(k*+2)]. The split already does this with fzero. Report when no root exists in the bounds.
required_fixes.verify: In test_precast_stage3_solve case D, assert r.check.equalities(1).pass. It is reachable because M_min = 4805.495 kg < rho_w V_hull = 9225 kg, and the lightest design floats at vs = 0.937237 m. Print vs and the residuals.

required_fixes.issue: F7 is called 3 times at the unchanged Stage-2 vs, against contract section 7 item 3 (one call while the draft is fixed).
required_fixes.fix: Seed solve's hs cache with the split's {vs, hs}, for example through P.hs0, and return the cache in sol. Reuse the cached hs in the final evaluate when design.vs is bitwise equal to a cached vs.
required_fixes.verify: Octave profile of a run that does not release the draft (e.g. grader_known_optimum.m) shows hydrostatics_at_draft called exactly once.

required_fixes.issue: The draft is released (draft_free runs) whenever the previous step's chosen point fails its adaptive rebuild (r.failed). This happens even if another evaluated point of that step held flotation. It contradicts AGENTS section 3 item 31: the draft is released only when mass balance cannot be met at the Stage-2 draft.
required_fixes.fix: When the step's chosen point cannot be rebuilt, fall back through the step's ranked evaluated points, as the final closest-fail loop at lines 114-130 already does. Decide the release on the best buildable point.
required_fixes.verify: Add a test where the provider fails the adaptive fit only at the best point while another point holds flotation: draft_free must not run. Alternatively, extend test_precast_solve_failed_evals so that this case is asserted.

required_fixes.issue: The test asserts that the stored solver(end).fval and max_eq_violation equal those of the stored props, and calls this exact by construction. The least_violation branch (solve.m lines 106-130) can store a design taken from another step's evaluations than solver(end). So the property holds in these cases but is not guaranteed by the code.
required_fixes.fix: Make it hold by construction. For example, record in sol which step and point the stored design comes from, and set the solver entry of the step that produced it. Otherwise reword the comment and assert only when the stored design is the last step's point.
required_fixes.verify: The header comment and the assertion agree with solve.m. The test still passes.

spec_issues: Orchestrator decision 1 (per-module t_max,i = d_close over module i - eps_fit/2) contradicts contract section 7 item 2: 'S2 sets keyed by the bitwise value of t only, each fitted once over the full hollow range'. Any t above d_close(hollow range) - eps_fit/2 closes the void somewhere in that range, so its set can only cover a span. The implementation keys sets by t and range (realise_modules.m lines 52-56). Section 7 item 4 then reuses the knots_from of one set (fitted over the whole range) for sets fitted over other z ranges. This cannot be tested until the real F2 (T2) is merged, so the contract text needs amending before J1/J2.

Brief decision 1 bounds t_max,i by 'd_close(z_range of module i's hollow part)'. For k* (and for k*+1 under spill) the hollow part is [z_ballast, top], which moves with the solver variable z_ballast, so it cannot be a fixed bound. The implementation uses the whole module range, a fixed bound at or below the brief's. It is conservative and would matter only when the narrowest part of k* lies below z_ballast (e.g. a keel region). Owner or orchestrator to confirm.

The closest-fail rule says 'the iterate with the smallest equality violation' (AGENTS section 3 item 27, section 5 item 11), while item 32 requires flotation in every reported state. The implementation ranks flotation-held points first and orders the rest by the max-norm. This reading needs owner confirmation; the implementer also raised it.

Plan T6 acceptance 'C1 run under the Octave shim; report printed' cannot be met in this lane: the real kernel (T2/T3) is not merged, and the owner allows no whole-pipeline run before J2. It is deferred to J2 per contract section 6 and remains not met here.

tests/octave_shims/fmincon.m is not in the contract section-4 ownership map. T6 changed it (+6 lines: empty multipliers when sqp's QP fails) so that its tests run. This is test-only and within reason, but the orchestrator should record the ownership.
